svg.title: Queens Neighborhoods
svg.desc: Chris Whong / NYC Neighborhood Boundaries contributors, derived from Zillow (2017); commit a14c924b16ce659d034ab15a8f45229b05a1f1f5. CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Borough extraction, duplicate merging, nonresidential context classification, overlap partition (smaller sub-neighborhoods first), shared-edge noding, projection, rounding, SVG and thumbnail conversion. Derived NYC map assets are CC BY-SA 4.0. Preview geometry simplified.
